d: Long, wavy ash-brown hair with thick bangs is partially covered by a grey newsboy cap. Calm, narrow light-blue eyes sit on a youthful, soft-featured face. The build is slender, dressed in a navy blue overcoat over a white high-waisted dress with blue trim, complemented by a chunky white knitted scarf, a brown leather belt, and dark brown lace-up boots. Accessories include a large ornate brown book held in one arm, a rolled parchment in the hand, and a glowing vintage lantern hanging from the book.
